confounded.assignment: A=B=4*I(U+0.4*z>0), U unobserved and contributes 0.8*U to outcome

randomized.assignment: conditionally independent channel draws given z: P(A=4|z)=0.35 if z<0 else 0.65; P(B=4|z)=0.65 if z<0 else 0.35; minimum joint-cell probability 0.1225
randomized.causal_identification: sequential randomized design premise; production identification still required
randomized.heldout: 24-step constant joint program is not used as an observed trajectory

whole_program_randomized.assignment: independent uniform draw among four complete programs at each group's origin
whole_program_randomized.exogenous_context: z and season paths are generated independently of whole-program assignment
whole_program_randomized.inference_limit: one retained group per program; no calibrated uncertainty or fit promotion

evidence.additive_variant: zero-interaction reference shares the same histories, covariates and noise

population: uniform over four retained groups, period-specific observed z and initial histories
target: mean scheduled-world response, then joint-a-b+reference; not predictive outcomes
